settings.codex_persistence: Existing runner retains write-capable native homes and child rollouts; no --ephemeral override.
settings.auth_cleanup: Launcher removes only the post-run isolated codex-home/auth.json symlink when its target matches AUTH_SOURCE. Source credential file is never read or unlinked. Home and rollouts retained.
settings.sandbox_and_approval: Unmodified existing runner restrictions, tools, allowed tools, strict MCP and empty setting sources; no override.
settings.bootstrap: Frozen original bootstrap runs only in runner-created disposable projects; launcher never executes Git in fixtures.

acceptance: All 18 original slots require independent full trace/response/artifact review and acceptance (18/18). Missing outcome/evidence and startup failures fail; no pooling, substitution, retries, supplemental models or automatic publication.
failure_policy: Preflight failure blocks all 18 declared slots. Runner startup failure or missing evidence remains in its slot; other slots continue without replacement. Source, criteria, prerequisite or implementation drift blocks remaining not-started slots. In-flight isolated runs retain all evidence. Failure triggers diagnosis then a separately declared fresh batch under the persistence contract. No unrelated process is killed.
